actions.name: Pan left
actions.description: Moves the view left over the map.

actions.name: Pan right
actions.description: Moves the view right over the map.

actions.name: Pan up
actions.description: Moves the view up over the map.

actions.name: Pan down
actions.description: Moves the view down over the map.

actions.name: Zoom in
actions.description: Closer to the map. The mouse wheel does the same.

actions.name: Zoom out
actions.description: Further from the map. The mouse wheel does the same.

actions.name: Back to the hero
actions.description: Puts the view back on the selected hero and follows them again.

actions.name: Sheet
actions.description: Opens and closes the character sheet.

actions.name: Gear
actions.description: Opens and closes the pack, and a chest or shop beside the hero.

actions.name: Spells
actions.description: Opens and closes the spell list.

actions.name: Journal
actions.description: Opens and closes the quests and companions.

actions.name: Camp
actions.description: Opens and closes rests and the camp.

actions.name: Save
actions.description: Writes the save now. Only between fights.

actions.name: Load
actions.description: Goes back to the last save. Only between fights.
